Source: GLPI App Structure ID 811 + Dataflows. Fetched: 2026-06-01.

APPLICATION: SAP ERP NALA
GLPI ID: 811
TYPE: OnPremise
STATUS: In Use
OWNER: OMDS IT > OMDG > SAP ERP
SERVICE LEVEL: Critical 24x7
INSTANCES: Integration+QA+Prod
TARGETS: Factory
DESCRIPTION: SAP Instance for US operations. Emails sent through SMTP Server.

ROLE IN ARCHITECTURE:
SAP ERP NALA is the core ERP system for OMDS North/Latin America operations (PE4 system code). Sister system to SAP ERP EMEA. Receives e-commerce orders from Magento and feeds data into the BIBU platform for BI processing. Also sends shipment tracking notifications via email.

INBOUND DATAFLOWS:
- Adobe Commerce Cloud Magento -> SAP ERP NALA: [MAGENTO]-[SAP ERP NALA] Order creation (ID: 270, via BIBU orchestration)

OUTBOUND DATAFLOWS:
- SAP ERP NALA -> BIBU: [SAPERP_PE4]-[SL_SAPPE4] Extraction (ID: 265) - feeds BIBU source layer
- SAP ERP NALA -> Office 365: [SAPERP_PE4]-[EMAIL] TRACKING SHIPMENT (ID: 46)

GAPS:
- No URL Production or QA recorded
- No supplier recorded
- No database recorded
- 143 open tickets, 24 open changes

APPLICATION: Mulesoft
GLPI ID: 803
TYPE: Cloud PaaS
STATUS: In Use
OWNER: OMDS IT > OMDG > BI and DevOps
SUPPLIER: Mulesoft
SERVICE LEVEL: Critical 24x7
INSTANCES: Prod
TARGETS: Strategic
USERS: Confidential
LICENSE METRIC: Daily

ROLE IN ARCHITECTURE:
Mulesoft is the central e-commerce integration middleware, acting as the bridge between Adobe Commerce Cloud Magento, SAP ERP EMEA, and ExDB. It orchestrates all order, customer, stock, shipment and return flows between the e-commerce front-end and the ERP back-end.

INBOUND DATAFLOWS (12 flows):
- ExDB -> Mulesoft: [ExDB]-[Mulesoft] Material Synchro (ID: 127)
- ExDB -> Mulesoft: [ExDB]-[Mulesoft] Shipment Create (ID: 128)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Customer Create (ID: 131)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Customer Update (ID: 132)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Order Create (ID: 130)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Return Create (ID: 133)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> Mulesoft: [SAPERP]-[Mulesoft] Invoice Create (ID: 129)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> Mulesoft: [SAPERP]-[Mulesoft] Stock Synchro (ID: 126)

OUTBOUND DATAFLOWS (9 flows):
- Mulesoft -> Magento: [MULESOFT]-[MAGENTO] Invoice Create (ID: 137)
- Mulesoft -> Magento: [MULESOFT]-[MAGENTO] Material Synchro (ID: 135)
- Mulesoft -> Magento: [MULESOFT]-[MAGENTO] Shipment Create (ID: 136)
- Mulesoft -> Magento: [MULESOFT]-[MAGENTO] Stock Synchro (ID: 134)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Customer Create or Update (ID: 123)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] N/A (ID: 124)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Order Create (ID: 20)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Order Status (ID: 259)
- Mulesoft -> SAP ERP EMEA: [Mulesoft]-[SAPERP] Return Create (ID: 125)

- No source repository linked

APPLICATION: MyOMSYSTEM
GLPI ID: 792

SERVICE LEVEL: SLA Non-ERP
INSTANCES: Integration+QA+Prod

ROLE IN ARCHITECTURE:
MyOMSYSTEM is the OMDS customer self-service portal (public-facing). It integrates with SAP ERP for product data, PIM Service for benefits/repair/exchange data, Service Tool for service status syncs, and feeds data to BIBU and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

INBOUND DATAFLOWS (7 flows):
- PIM Service -> MyOMSYSTEM: [PIM_Service]-[MyOM] Benefits Sync (ID: 140)
- PIM Service -> MyOMSYSTEM: [PIM_Service]-[MyOM] Repair SYNC (ID: 141)
- PIM Service -> MyOMSYSTEM: [PIM_Service]-[MyOM] Upg-Exch Sync (ID: 142)
- SAP ERP -> MyOMSYSTEM: [SAP-ERP]-[MYOM] Product Export (ID: 253)
- Service Tool -> MyOMSYSTEM: [SRV-TOOL]-[MYOM] Service sync (ID: 86)
- Service Tool -> MyOMSYSTEM: [SVT]-[MyOM] Promo Status (ID: 144)
- Service Tool -> MyOMSYSTEM: [SVT]-[MyOM] Rental Status (ID: 145)
- Service Tool -> MyOMSYSTEM: [SVT]-[MyOM] Repair_Redo Status (ID: 258)

OUTBOUND DATAFLOWS (5 flows):
- MyOMSYSTEM -> SAP CRM Marketing: [MYOM/EXPLORE]-[SAP MKT] BUPA_MANAGEMENT (ID: 240)
- MyOMSYSTEM -> Sprinx CRM: [MyOM]-[SPRX] Case Create (ID: 255)
- MyOMSYSTEM -> Salesforce Marketing Cloud: [MYOM]-[SalesForce] Promo Emails (ID: 254)
- MyOMSYSTEM -> BIBU: [MYOM]-[SL_01] (ID: 146)
- MyOMSYSTEM -> BIBU: [MYOM]-[SL_01] Extraction (ID: 268)

APPLICATION: ExDB
GLPI ID: 844
TYPE: OnPremise
STATUS: In Use

SUPPLIER: SAP Deutschland SE & Co. KG
SERVICE LEVEL: SLA Non-ERP
DATABASE: SQL Server
TARGETS: Factory
USERS: Confidential
LICENSE METRIC: Daily

ROLE IN ARCHITECTURE:
ExDB is an internal data store (child of SAP ERP EMEA) that acts as an intermediate layer between SAP ERP EMEA and Mulesoft. SAP ERP EMEA pushes core business objects (customers, items, sales orders, deliveries) into ExDB, which then feeds Mulesoft for e-commerce integration.

INBOUND DATAFLOWS (4 flows, all from SAP ERP EMEA):
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] CUSTOMER (ID: 110)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] ITEM (ID: 109)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] SALES DELIVERY (ID: 113)
- SAP ERP EMEA -> ExDB: [SAP-ERP]-[ExDB] SALES ORDER (ID: 112)

OUTBOUND DATAFLOWS (2 flows, to Mulesoft):
- ExDB -> Mulesoft: [ExDB]-[Mulesoft] Material Synchro (ID: 127)
- ExDB -> Mulesoft: [ExDB]-[Mulesoft] Shipment Create (ID: 128)

- No URL Production or QA recorded
- No instances recorded

- SAP CRM Marketing -> Explore.omsystem: [SAP OZP]-[EXPLORE] (ID: 21)
- SAP CRM Marketing -> BIBU: SAP_MKT > SAP_Base_Load I change (ID: 61, DEVEL)

ROLE IN ARCHITECTURE:
Adobe Commerce Cloud Magento is the OMDS e-commerce platform managing online sales across 3 regions (APAC, EMEA, NALA). It feeds raw transactional data into BIBU for BI processing and integrates bidirectionally with Mulesoft for ERP order management. Also receives vouchers from SFMC and stock updates.

INBOUND DATAFLOWS (6 flows):

- Mulesoft -> Magento: [MULESOFT]-[MAGENTO] Material Synchro (ID: 135)

- Mulesoft -> Magento: [MULESOFT]-[MAGENTO] Stock Synchro (ID: 134)
- SFMC -> Magento: [SFMC]-[Magento] Voucher (ID: 256)
- SL01 -> Magento: [SL01]-[Magento] Stock Update (ID: 257)

OUTBOUND DATAFLOWS (7 flows):
- Magento -> BIBU: [MAGENTO]-[SL_APAC_SHOP] Extraction (ID: 210, ACTIVE)
- Magento -> BIBU: [MAGENTO]-[SL_EMEA_SHOP] Extraction (ID: 148, ACTIVE, partner: Scandiweb)
- Magento -> BIBU: [MAGENTO]-[SL_NALA_SHOP] Extraction (ID: 209, ACTIVE)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Customer Create (ID: 131)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Customer Update (ID: 132)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Order Create (ID: 130)
- Magento -> Mulesoft: [MAGENTO]-[MULESOFT] Return Create (ID: 133)
